subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, and mtime for transcript-mentioned paths that are outside or rejected by the fs-safe workspace boundary?
rationale: The PR's backend behavior crosses an intentional file-access boundary, and automation cannot choose between filtering external entries, adding a neutral outside-workspace state, or deliberately exposing external metadata.

options.title: Restore workspace containment
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix false Missing UX through filtering or a neutral outside-workspace state that does not reveal external file metadata.

options.title: Split the UI layout fix
options.body: Keep any needed rail CSS separately and leave external-file semantics to the linked backend issue or a new focused PR.

options.title: Accept external metadata deliberately
options.body: Allow the metadata exposure only with explicit maintainer/security approval and tests documenting the new contract.

recommendation.title: Restore workspace containment
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and fix false Missing UX through filtering or a neutral outside-workspace state that does not reveal external file metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original workspace rail feature and appear in recent history for the affected Gateway/UI files.
